narr: Thunderstorms moved northwest across southeast Arizona during the afternoon. Heavy rain resulted in flash flooding in parts of the Tucson Metro area and a funnel cloud was spotted near Three Points.
ev: Heavy rain of 1.5-2.5 in 90 minutes caused flash flooding and road closures in Picture Rocks. A school bus became stuck in floodwaters at Ina and Sandario Rds.
Heavy rain of 1.5-2.5 caused flash flooding and road closures in southwest Tucson along Camino Verde as well as Old Ajo Hwy.
Heavy rain of 1.5-2.5 in less than 2 hours caused flash flooding in Oro Valley and the closures of Overton and Hardy Roads and Linda Vista Blvd.
